author: SGMC
body:
If this has already been mentioned, lock please. I haven't seen it though. 

Anyways, it's been a problem for me and I think some others, that in minigames sprint jumping up stairs makes anticheat think you're flyhacking. About half the time I try to sprint jump up a few blocks of stairs, I get a message along the lines of: "[AntiCheat] Fly hacking detected on the Y axis! Don't move for 5 seconds to prevent damage!" Then I need to stand completely still for 5 seconds to be able to move again. It's gotten me killed in nebula a few times, and once in a walls match, while running up the stairs in the center of Overworld. I'm not sure if it's a fixable glitch, but it's quite annoying, especially the having to wait for 5 seconds part. Has this been happening to anyone else, and is there a way to fix it?
